description: Use the legacy parser's native HAUL OBJECT form and choose the bounded authored one-room route from the furnishing identity and its real current House room.

replacements.old:
<SYNTAX HAUL OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) WESTWARD = V-R1277-HAUL-WEST>
<SYNTAX HAUL OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) EASTWARD = V-R1277-HAUL-EAST>
<SYNTAX HAUL OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) UPSTAIRS = V-R1277-HAUL-UP>
<SYNTAX HAUL OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) DOWNSTAIRS = V-R1277-HAUL-DOWN>
<SYNTAX HAUL OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) OUTSIDE = V-R1277-HAUL-OUT>
<SYNONYM HAUL DRAG>
replacements.new:
<SYNTAX HAUL OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) = V-R1277-HAUL>
<SYNONYM HAUL DRAG>

replacements.old: HAUL it one real House route at a time -- for example, HAUL " D ,PRSO " WESTWARD -- and the route itself decides whether it fits.
replacements.new: HAUL it one real House route at a time. Release 1277 uses the furnishing and its actual House room to select the bounded authored route, then the geometry decides whether it fits.
